subject.title: [model-catalog] FsSafeError: directory changed during operation — catalog write races with reader, loops every ~1min

question: For the linked fix PR, is deterministic @openclaw/fs-safe boundary proof sufficient without live authenticated Anthropic/systemd gateway logs?
rationale: The source and tests target the repaired failure boundary, but the original production gateway scenario has not been rerun, and that proof-sufficiency choice belongs to a maintainer before using the PR to close this issue.

options.title: Accept Boundary Proof
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR after exact-head checks because it covers the private-store write retry and same-agent sidecar read serialization paths.

options.title: Request Live Gateway Logs
options.body: Ask for redacted Anthropic/systemd gateway logs and catalog-file evidence before merging the linked PR and closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Accept Boundary Proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR after exact-head checks because it covers the private-store write retry and same-agent sidecar read serialization paths.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to the issue and has recent history in the affected model-catalog internals.
